documents.title: Vehicle return and inspection playbook
documents.content: At return, confirm the rental agreement, record mileage and fuel, inspect the exterior and interior, photograph new damage, and close the contract only after the inspection checklist is complete.

documents.title: Branch opening checklist
documents.content: The opening agent verifies keys, telematics status, registration documents, clean-ready vehicles, safety equipment, and the day’s reservations before opening the counter.

documents.title: Vehicle maintenance escalation
documents.content: A warning light, unsafe tire, failed brake inspection, or immobilized vehicle requires a maintenance ticket and fleet coordinator review before the vehicle returns to service.

documents.title: Fuel and mileage exceptions
documents.content: Document fuel or mileage exceptions with a contract note, supporting photo, and manager approval. Never overwrite the original agreement values.

documents.title: Clean-ready vehicle standard
documents.content: A vehicle is clean-ready when the cabin is vacuumed, glass and mirrors are clear, warning labels are visible, the fuel level is recorded, and no personal property remains inside.

documents.title: Inter-branch vehicle transfer
documents.content: Before transferring a vehicle, confirm the receiving branch, current mileage, fuel level, damage status, key count, and open maintenance tickets in the fleet record.
